docs.title: Home
docs.text:
a simple communication framework for Roblox that unifies local events, networking, and synchronized state into a single, consistent API.

Signal automatically creates and manages networking instances behind the scenes, eliminating manual setup and preventing common networking pitfalls such as race conditions.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Local Signals
  • RemoteEvents
  • UnreliableRemoteEvents
  • RemoteFunctions
  • State Synchronization
  • Guaranteed ACK Delivery
  • Replay Buffers
  • Event Deduplication
  • Request Rate Limiting
  • Promise-based Invocations
  • Built-in Bandwidth Profiler
  • Debug Logging
  • Automatic Remote Creation
  • Automatic Remote Caching
  • Unified Client & Server API

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Place the package inside ReplicatedStorage.

ReplicatedStorage
└── Packages
    └── Signal

Require it anywhere.

local Signal = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Signal)

That's it.

Signal automatically creates and manages all networking instances. No folders, RemoteEvents, or RemoteFunctions need to be created manually.

docs.title: Local Signal
docs.text:
local Changed = Signal.new()

Changed:Connect(function(value)
    print("Changed:", value)
end)

Changed:Fire(10)

docs.title: Remote Event
docs.text:
local Damage = Signal.Event("Damage")

Damage:FireServer(20)

docs.title: Remote Function
docs.text:
local Inventory = Signal.Function("Inventory")

Inventory:InvokeServerAsync()
    :andThen(function(data)
        print(data.Coins)
    end)

docs.title: State Synchronization
docs.text:
-- Server
local Gold = Signal.State("PlayerGold", 100)

Gold:Set(250)

-- Client
Signal.State("PlayerGold"):Observe(function(value)
    print(value)
end)

docs.title: Unreliable Event
docs.text:
local Effects = Signal.Unreliable("Effects")

Effects:FireAll(Vector3.new(0, 10, 0))

Continue to the Guide for the complete API reference, advanced features, and practical examples.

docs.title: Guide
docs.text: This guide covers every feature available in Signal, from local signals to advanced networking features.

docs.title: Local Signals
docs.text:
Local signals never cross the network and execute only in the environment they were created.

local Changed = Signal.new()

Changed:Connect(function(value)
    print(value)
end)

Changed:Fire(100)

docs.title: Methods
docs.text: Method Description Connect(callback) Connects a listener. Once(callback) Runs once then disconnects. Wait() Yields until fired. Fire(...) Fires the signal. Destroy() Cleans up the signal.

docs.title: Remote Events
docs.text:
Reliable communication between the server and clients.

Create or retrieve an event.

local Damage = Signal.Event("Damage")

docs.title: Server
docs.text:
Damage:Connect(function(player, amount)
    print(player.Name, "took", amount, "damage")
end)

Damage:FireClient(player, 20)

Damage:FireAll(20)

Damage:FireExcept(player, 20)

docs.title: Client
docs.text:
Damage:Connect(function(amount)
    print("Received damage:", amount)
end)

Damage:FireServer(20)

docs.title: Replay Buffers
docs.text:
Replay Buffers remember previous payloads so late-loading clients immediately receive the latest state.

local GameState = Signal.Event("GameState")
    :SetReplayBuffer(1)

GameState:FireAll("Intermission", 30)

docs.title: Deduplication
docs.text:
Ignore duplicate fires within a configurable cooldown.

local Attack = Signal.Event("Attack")
    :SetDeduplication(0.5)

docs.title: Remote Functions
docs.text:
Remote Functions allow clients to request data from the server.

local Inventory = Signal.Function("Inventory")

docs.title: Server
docs.text:
Inventory:SetRateLimit(5)

Inventory:SetCallback(function(player)
    return {
        Coins = 100,
        Gems = 10,
    }
end)

docs.title: Synchronous
docs.text:
local Data = Inventory:InvokeServer()

print(Data.Coins)

docs.title: Asynchronous
docs.text:
Inventory:InvokeServerAsync()
    :andThen(function(data)
        print(data.Coins)
    end)
    :catch(function(err)
        warn(err)
    end)

docs.title: Guaranteed ACK Delivery
docs.text:
Guarantees that important packets reach the client before continuing.

Perfect for:

  • Rewards
  • Purchases
  • Cutscenes
  • Trading
  • Match Results
local Reward = Signal.Event("GiveReward")

task.spawn(function()

    local Success = Reward:FireClientWithAck(
        player,
        "LegendarySword"
    )

    if Success then
        print("Client confirmed receipt!")
    end

end)

Client

Reward:Connect(function(item)

    print(item)

end)

Signal automatically handles acknowledgment packets.

docs.title: State Synchronization
docs.text: Synchronize server-side values with client observers.

docs.title: Server
docs.text:
local Gold = Signal.State("PlayerGold", 100)

Gold:Set(250)

docs.title: Client
docs.text:
Signal.State("PlayerGold"):Observe(function(value)

    print(value)

end)

docs.title: Unreliable Events
docs.text:
Uses Roblox's UnreliableRemoteEvent for high-frequency, non-critical communication.

Ideal for:

  • Particles
  • Camera Shake
  • Bullet Tracers
  • Footsteps
  • Character Movement
  • Vehicle Physics
local Effects = Signal.Unreliable("Effects")

Server

Effects:FireAll(position)

Client

Effects:FireServer(position)

docs.title: Debug Logging
docs.text:
Enable lifecycle logs while developing.

Signal.SetDebug(true)

Example:

[Signal] Created Event "Damage"
[Signal] Connected "Damage"
[Signal] Fired "Damage"
[Signal] Destroyed "Damage"

Disable logging.

Signal.SetDebug(false)

docs.title: Bandwidth Profiler
docs.text:
Monitor packet counts and payload sizes.

Signal.EnableProfiler(true)

Example report:

--- [Signal Bandwidth Report] ---

Remote: FetchInventory
Calls: 4
Data: 0.24 KB

Remote: PlayerGold
Calls: 2
Data: 0.06 KB

docs.title: Automatic Registry
docs.text:
Signal automatically manages networking instances.

When you call

Signal.Event("Damage")

Signal will automatically:

  • Create the remote on the server if it doesn't exist.
  • Wait safely for replication on the client.
  • Cache the remote for future lookups.
  • Prevent duplicate creation.
  • Organize networking instances internally.

No manual setup inside ReplicatedStorage is required.

docs.title: Constructors
docs.text: Constructor Description Signal.new Creates a local signal. Signal.Event(name) Gets or creates a RemoteEvent. Signal.Function(name) Gets or creates a RemoteFunction. Signal.Unreliable(name) Gets or creates an UnreliableRemoteEvent. Signal.State(name, default) Creates or retrieves a synchronized state.
